description: Get a URL the human can open to view and edit the SAVED design in CE.SDK. Returns the design's stable URL — it survives re-saving, so print it ONCE and don't re-emit a fresh URL every turn. The page is a full editor; when the human clicks 'Save', their edits land in the same design file. Nothing is viewable until you have saved with `export({ format: 'imgly' })`. The editor opens in the mode the human last chose for this design, else 'motion' (timeline) when the design has animation, video, audio or timed blocks and 'design' otherwise; pass `mode` to force one.

mode.description: Editor mode to open in: 'motion' shows the timeline and clip tools, 'design' the still-design editor.

name: view
